TEXT: [FI] Well then, how do we get back at them...

[FI] We decided to turn our date into one with a 
strategy meeting, so we're headed towards the 
usual karaoke place to talk.

[FI] While we were walking towards the station, we 
heard someone's voice.
[FI] So this is the first time they have met, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Let me introduce you. She's my childhood friend, 
Tamura Manami.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Won't this turn out gloomy again, since she's going 
to object, just like the others?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] If it's okay with you, I hope we can be friends.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah... please be kind to me as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Mhmm, I'm glad~. If anything's troubling you, feel 
free to come talk to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I feel I can really be useful in these situations.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Somehow you seem to be too much of a good 
person, super suspicious...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry Manami, even I felt that way myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, in her case, it's impossible for her to feign 
kindness.

[FI] If this girl's been feigning kindness, then I would 
have been fooled for more than 10 years.
[FI] There's no way that could be true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, what are you up to? You're still mad 
regardless of whether people congratulate or 
oppose you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan and I don't have that kind of relationship.
[FI] So Kanako was worried over that.

[FI] If I put myself in her shoes, she's meeting a boy's 
close childhood friend.
[FI] Of course she'd be worried, even a bit jealous.
[FI] In situations like this, I'm an idiot, as always.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I hope you can trust Kyou-chan more.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Oh. I don't want to be a bother, so I'm going to 
take my leave now.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I've still got stuff I want to talk about, but... maybe 
next time!
